children: Motilal Oswal's research report on Shree Cement

Shree Cement (SRCM)’s 2QFY27 EBITDA was above our estimate, driven by higher-than-estimated volume growth/OPM. Standalone revenue grew ~19% YoY to INR51.1b, driven by robust volume growth (up ~18% YoY; 8% beat). EBITDA declined ~3% YoY to INR8.5b (~18% beat). EBITDA/t dipped ~18% YoY to INR912 (vs. est. INR837). OPM contracted 3.7pp YoY to ~17% (est. ~16%). PAT declined ~30% YoY to INR2.1b (~17% beat).

We estimate EBITDA/t of INR1,018/INR1,074 in FY27/ FY28 vs. INR1,174 in FY26. SRCM trades fairly at 17x/15x FY27E/FY28E EV/EBITDA. We reiterate our Neutral rating with a TP of INR25,060 (based on 16x FY28E EV/EBITDA).
